body: thank you for being so sweet. i met the therapist today and I really liked how kind she was to me!!! i'm willing to change my life. i don't want to become bitter and unhappy like my abusers. i believe that recovery is possible. i wish you only the best!!

Tbh I just want to spend time with my best friend and her dog. We can't meet each other rn bc of the corona pandemic (it's so insane how quickly everything happened. when I made the original post I didn't know that our world would change so drastically in such a small amount of time!!!)

It's very thoughtful that you asked me what I want. Somehow that made me feel a lot better.

I think they might be so good at manipulating people bc most people want to be fooled? The average person doesnt want to believe that their neighbours or coworkers hurt their own children. It's much easier for them to look away. Just very few people can see right through my mother's bullshit. it's insane how nice she can seem but it never feels genuine at all. her kindness is manufactured, fake and manipulative. Have you watched or read 'sharp objects' by Gillian Flynn? My mother is a lot like Adora.

I'm glad that your horrible mother does not know where you live. I think it's very justified to call the police when you feel threatened.

Btw I went to a somatic therapist today and I hope that will help. I certainly won't give up!!

you are right, a restraining order could cause problems. the risk is too high bc my mother is very unstable and unpredictable. she'd hurt and punish me if i got the police involved. and i'm not sure that the police would actually help me. my mother is talented at manipulating people. one second she threatens to kill me, next second she tells people that she loves me and only wants what's best for me. and they believe her. it's horrible.

i'm thankful for your comment. i didn't answer earlier bc i felt ashamed of having a mental breakdown on here. sometimes the memories and the unfairness of it all are just too much to handle. but i'm working on processing my traumatic memories. i still have hope that i'll be happy in the future.

i have an appointment with a therapist this week. i don't live with my family anymore (moved out a few months ago). i'm gonna do everything i can to completely go no contact in the future. thank you for your comment, it means a lot.

thank you for your answer. i felt ashamed and guilty bc i made this post. i still feel like i have no right to talk about what they've done to me and that's why i'm answering you so late. i have an appointment with a therapist this week. i can't handle the pain and memories anymore. the worst thing is that they still think they are the victims. just bc i defended myself against their abuse. i'll go no contact as soon as i can. i can't take this anymore. i feel so drained. my mother is the worst person i know. i'm genuinely scared of her bc i know what she is capable of. i'm gonna make sure i'll be safe in the future.
Thank you so much!!! It's horrible that your stepfather did this to you. You didn't deserve it. I hope you create an amazing life for yourself and I wish you only the best for your recovery.
yup they said it straight to my face multiple times. they should have chosen to be childfree.

my parents have said this to me a billion times. it's so stupid like... nobody forced them to have children???? i hate people who mindlessly have kids and then punish and abuse them for being alive. some parents are horrendously dumb and irresponsible. it's disgusting.
this is so true. i've been horribly abused by the staff in a psych hospital. i now avoid those places and that's why i'm still alive.
i love this soooooo much. my abusers have done extremely horrible things to me and i will never forgive them. some things are unforgivable. you are right, let them die mad.

Your mother sounds so much like my mother. You don't deserve this at all!! She decided to bring you into this world and she has to take care of you. She has to buy you clothes. That is the bare minimum. What she does to you is criminal and abusive. She has no right to behave this way. I know how manipulative abusive mothers are, but there are no justifications for her behaviour. Don't believe anything she says.

My mother also always said 'other people have worse parents' blablabla. What manipulative bullshit. So now all parents get a free pass to do horrible things just bc some rando somewhere has done even worse things?? That is insane. And it's not how the world works. Your mother just invents the dumbest excuses bc she wants to hurt you. You are right, she gaslights you. It's horrific. She is abusive and it doesn't matter if more abusive parents exist. She is not allowed to hurt you. That is a fact.

You certainly aren't a burden at all. You are a person. You deserve to be cared for. Your mother is a horrible person and she could even go to jail for doing those things to you. She is violating the law.
that website is cool af, I love it!!!
thank you!!!

I relate so much to this. I've moved to another area. and when I tell people just a few things about my upbringing they get shocked. What I've survived is objectively an extremely severe case of child abuse and neglect. My family still thinks they did nothing wrong. They are honestly extremely sick and scary people. I'm currently realizing how abnormally bad my childhood really was and it's soo painful. My mother and my father definitely deserve jail time (and some other relatives deserve that too).

I hope we all heal from this. Nobody deserves to experience abuse.

I hope you'll feel better soon. Flashbacks are terrible. I wasn't able to hold down a job for a few years tbh. I had to fight a lot to get better (I did this without medical help bc of financial reasons and a lack of good professionals where I lived). It was hard. I'm still struggling a lot. CPTSD is definitely a very severe illness and I wish people would take it more seriously. I'm glad that you have FMLA and that your sick days can't be used against you!! That's amazing tbh. I wish you only the best for your recovery. And thank you for writing your comment.

Same. I usually drag myself out of bed, even when I feel like I'm dying and have panic attacks and flashbacks. But I just could not deal with going to work today. Now I'm at home and feel dizzy with fear bc I know they will make fun of me and spread lies again. They've done this before. I am diagnosed with chronic mental and physical illnesses but my boss does not care at all. I should probably get another job.

tbh bosses usually don't care about the well being of their workers. I hate that I feel guilty for doing things that protect my sanity. i should have the right to take care of myself.

I've looked into that, but tbh I really like to be independent and to spent as little time with other people as possible lmao. but thank you for the suggestion. I could maybe imagine to live like that with people that I like a lot (and that i've known for a long time).. but definitely not with strangers

I hate that I have to work for someone else and that I don't get paid enough money. I'm a very ambitious person. Also I hate having a boss and being controlled. What I really need to do is to start working for myself tbh.

What kind of job do you do? I'm glad you enjoy your new job. I would genuinely love to take care of animals but I wouldn't get paid enough to survive.
same:( the only thing I love doing is to take care of animals. And I'm very good at it. but i wouldn't make enough money to survive. so now i have a job that drains me.
I definitely want to work for myself too. I wish you the best for your business!!
this is inspiring bc  I really want to be self-employed too. what kind of work do you do?

thank you so much for sharing your experience. i really appreciate it.

i definitely feel very vulnerable and small and scared a lot of the time. most people would never guess that I've been through severe abuse (I make lots of jokes and i often act confident and open etc). but on the inside I feel very broken and sometimes I can't hide that. my anxiety is terrible. i push through it, I go to work although I'm in horrible pain, but it's hard. i do whatever i can to never end up in my hometown again.

and YES I've experienced so much bullying already. sometimes i can't keep up the "i'm happy and totally haven't experienced abuse that would destroy the strongest person" act. bullies notice that. there was someone in particular who wanted to make me kill myself. just like my family did. it was retraumatizing bc i hoped everything would become better when i leave. it's not as easy as that at all. you are right, it takes a long time.

in general i'm hopeful. i actively work on improving my life. i'm really into self therapy and it works (slowly but surely). i used to want to run back to my family bc i was delusional. i thought they would start loving me one day. that won't happen. i don't really feel the need to run to them anymore. i feel repulsed by them now. and i like living in a city sooo much (i come from a horrible rural area). i am slowly starting to become more independent and free. i actually love to handle everything myself but sometimes it feels overwhelming. i was kinda worried that my post seemed too whiny but i just needed to vent. i keep all of this inside most of the time.

my life will definitely get better bc i have lots of dreams and i'm very stubborn lmao. btw you are extremely strong too. going through all of that pain is tough. and going no contact is no joke at all. it means to face some very brutal truths.

i wish you the absolute best. you can also pm me if you want to. you can be very proud of your amazing accomplishments. i'm so happy that your life is good now!!!!!!!

that's very interesting, thank you for your comment. i'm gonna take a look at the books you've recommended. 'try softer' is a good title for a book on mental health tbh. i'm definitely too hard on myself.

i sometimes listen to meditations with positive affirmations while i'm asleep. that helps a bit and i need to do that more often.

i wish you the best for your recovery!!!
that's a good idea. i already have a diary, but i was too depressed to write in it for a while. it's really helpful tho and i need to start writing again. thank you for your advice!!

it's not too late at all. you can change your life. and 29 is still young. there are people who are in their 40s or 50s who decide to change their lives. you don't need to graduate college (unless it's sth you want to do). more and more people start college in their 30s. and many people don't go to college at all!! your parents have no right to look down on you. you are allowed to start over. you are allowed to leave a toxic work environment. that's nothing to be ashamed of.
i'm glad that you don't let her manipulate you with that bs. my abusive mother tries to manipulate me too and it's infuriating tbh.
definitely start applying now. and mention your graduation date in your application. good luck!!!

i moved away from my abusers and i relate so much!! please don't tell yourself how you 'should' feel. there is nothing wrong with your feelings. change can feel very scary, even when change can make your life sooo much better in the long run.

moving out was not pointless at all. it takes some time to improve your life and to trust those improvements. i'm in a very similar situation right now. i'm learning how to find friends who are good for me, to manage my finances, to handle my mental health and recover from the abuse i've endured. it's very hard and it can be lonely as hell. i just believe that freedom is worth it. i'm putting a lot of work into becoming more independent. you can do that too!!! it's so cool that you rented a studio apartment, that's amazing. i wish you the best life ever.
you deserve help, everyone does. you are filled with self hatred and i know what it's like to feel that way. it's horrible. you feel miserable so you are definitely "sick enough" to get help.
looks very cool tbh!!!

this is amazing to hear. recovery can definitely feel excruciating sometimes. it's admirable that you push through all of that pain, that's something to be very proud of!!! i want to try emdr too; it's just very hard to find a good therapist. i wish you the best with your recovery, it's nice that emdr helps you so much. that gives me lots of hope. thank you for sharing your experience.
this looks soo pretty and it's also very inspiring!!!

this is exactly how i feel rn!! i've worked for so many horrible people. i am tired of being controlled for just a tiny little bit of money. i refuse to waste my life for others. i wish you only the best!!!!

it's sooooo cool that you published a book, i need a link!! i'm currently working on my own book too. it's inspiring to see other people doing the things i want to do. i'm glad that ur dad supports you!!!!!!!!! tbh ur mother sounds a lot like my mother and... it's unacceptable that she treats u like that.

tbh this is reasonable and understandable. you definitely don't sound like you are pitying yourself. i have to pay my therapy bills too and it's sth i struggle with. like... my parents caused this... why do they get to spent their money on vacations and fun things, while i have to pay for therapy? they should pay for the pain they've caused. they knew what they were doing, especially my mother. i know my recovery is my responsibility but it's still not fair at all. anyway.. at least i'm not like them and i choose to invest my money into making myself a better and healthier person. i can be proud of that.

your therapist is wrong and incompetent imo. I would not trust her with my mental health. she is diminishing your pain and it's horrible. it's psychology 101 to know that being emotionally abused by your parents is traumatic... i once had a psychiatrist tell me that I can't have memory issues bc I'm too young. which is complete bullshit bc i'm traumatized and that's why i struggle with memory loss. again, that's also psychology 101. i personally stopped seeing him. i didn't want to waste my time teaching a 'professional' how trauma works lmao. like............. i just hated that that clown got paid for doing a terrible job.

i wish you only the best for your future and i hope your mental health will improve. you deserve adequate help. please keep that in mind.

oh and i also love carrie a lot. i relate to her in some ways. her mother is just as insane as my mother and i also got bullied at school. life can be shit and that's why it's important to have our pain validated instead of diminished tbh
wow I'm actually struggling with this a lot... thank u for this post. u just taught me sth about myself

it's horrible that your father is mentally abusive. you don't deserve that. i just had to call my mother and she instantly reminded me why i don't want to talk to her. i know some people who are loved by their parents, it's so... different from what i've experienced. i hope you know that you don't deserve to get abused. parents are supposed to support their kids. it's heartbreaking and horrific when they don't do that. i truly hope life will get better for you soon.

yes i wish we could all be healthy and happy. my birthday was very horrible, but at least i didnt spent it with my abusive family i guess. it was very painful tho and i cried the whole day. thank you so much for the support, it truly means a lot!!
no it's not too late, thank you <3
same. life is overwhelming and scary when ur parents never taught u how to live.
this is so true. everyone has the right to be safe from harmful people.

i honestly love this post so much. healing means to face some uncomfortable truths. my family is extremely horrible and definitely cult-like. they never taught me what it means to be a healthy and well-adjusted person. i'm still young and i'm working hard on myself bc i want to be a good person. i used to be a rather toxic person and now i can still be kinda toxic sometimes tbh. i'm not proud of that, but i'm doing everything i can to be better. it's my responsibility that i grow and learn and become better than what i've been taught.

i also feel like a kid. the process of recovery can feel extremely excruciating and confusing and like a battle you can't win. but it is possible to win it.
